evidence.quote: Finally, the present results are limited to simulation. How the controllers perform in real-world fluid systems, and whether the acquired control strategies and design knowledge can support simulation-to-real transfer, remain to be established.
establishing which structures account for robustness across different environments remains a question for further study.

First, controller evaluation in the present study relies entirely on high-fidelity CFD simulations. Whether agents can learn to autonomously use or train surrogate models to reduce simulation cost is an important question for further work.

Second, the present approach provides physical interpretations of how the generated controllers operate. An interesting next step is whether agents can formalize this understanding mathematically, translating observed mechanisms into models with explicit assumptions and deriving conditions under which they remain effective. Such formalization could support analytical predictions of controller behaviour and, ultimately, theoretical guarantees.
